name: Elemental Expressionist — both quoted abilities go to the chosen target, neither to the source
notes: Memory: project_elemental_expressionist_and_quoted_follows_target_2026-10-16. 'Choose target creature you control. Until end of turn, it gains "If this creature would leave the battlefield, exile it instead …" and "When this creature is put into exile, create a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token."' The second quoted ability (the 'and "…"' continuation) was built without the target's restriction, so the fired trigger pinned it to Elemental Expressionist itself. Fired twice: once with no target chosen (nothing changes), once at Grizzly Bears (the Bears gain both).
